source: Suhayl 9 (2009-2010), the edition of the Arabic text by George Saliba (page image)
role: AB_SMALL_WORK (text and charts); MODERN_EDITORIAL (apparatus, line numbers, brackets)
comment: Printed p. 17: the title page of the edition. The Arabic title is printed as an image in a heavy display type, in three centred lines; the English title below it is the article's and is not transcribed.

lines.text: كتاب جابر بن سنان الحرّاني البتّاني

observations: L01-L03: the title page has no line numbers, folio or apparatus. The English title printed below the image, «Jābir ibn Sinān al-Ḥarrānī al-Battānī's Book on the Indications of Conjunctions and Eclipses», is the article's and is not reproduced. The text itself (p. 18) gives the author's name as «محمد بن جابر البتّاني».
